summary: All 16 Extract Analysis badges are now Quotation Analysis; no stem or mark scheme in this unit referred to a printed extract, so no stem needed rewriting. Job 2 is BLOCKED: exam_tip_html is null on all 8 lessons, and the applier can only edit text fields that already have content, so the 30-mark paragraph needs a separate write.
exam_tip_paragraph_text: In the exam this cluster is one question worth 30 marks: one poem is printed for you, and you compare it with a second poem you choose from memory. The shorter tasks in this lesson build the parts of that answer, so they are practice for the skills and not the shape of the real question.
